title: In a DVR every nonzero element is a unit times a power of a uniformizer
statement: Let $B$ be a Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] local domain whose maximal ideal $\mathfrak m_B$ is generated by a single nonzero element $\pi$, i.e. $\mathfrak m_B=\pi B$ with $\pi\neq0$ (a discrete valuation ring, Stacks Algebra Lemma Tag 00PD, condition (4)). Then every nonzero element $b\in B$ can be written as $b=u\pi^n$ with $u\in B$ a unit and $n\ge0$ an integer.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00PD (lemma-characterize-dvr), condition (4) and the final assertion ('every nonzero element of A can be uniquely written as u pi^n'); the uniqueness is not stated here
